$comment: Runtime config for this landing. This file is served as-is from the public folder and is fetched by the page on every load, so editing it changes the landing WITHOUT a rebuild. Reload the page (or let the dev watcher pick it up) and the landing re-renders.

game.$comment: credit/bet are shown as-is in the bottom menu. symbols = file names under iconPath; mobile results refer to them by 1-based index. desktop.spins: none | small | big, in order (past the end = none); the popup opens after a big spin. mobile.spins: type loss | smallwin | bigwin, winLine = row 0-2 per reel (null for loss), result = per reel top-to-bottom symbol numbers; the popup opens after the last one.

assets.$comment: Values are either a built-in key (a filename under src/assets/sound, no extension) or a URL. A URL starting with / , ./ , http:// or https:// is used verbatim, so you can drop custom audio into the public folder and point at it here.

dev.$comment: watch polls this file and re-renders the landing in place when it changes. menu enables the config editor panel (ships in production too, where it saves to this browser's localStorage).
